title: helenium autumnale var. pubescens
intro: Helenium autumnale var. pubescens, commonly known as autumn sneezeweed or hairy sneezeweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The plant's therapeutic actions may help to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
